assertions.name: delta_tr_is_not_form_A_delta_net
assertions.source: Leading Taylor coefficients differ (Δ(net)_A=-2ε, Δtr_M=-5/4ε), so the Habiro trace difference is not Form A's net-winding slot.

description: Decisive test: is the exact Habiro Δtr_M = tr_M(β_n) - tr_M(β_p) the same categorical object as Form A's single-wrap net winding Δ(net)_A = (q²-1)(q²-2q-1)/(2q²)? Substitutes Δtr_M into Form A's Δ(net) slot keeping E_0 = 1/(q(q-1)) and compares to CODATA Q_β. Zero free parameters. Determines whether Q_β consumes Δtr_M through Form A's slot or the bridge is a genuine open derivation.

form_A_factorization.note: Form A = m_e·|Δ(net)_A|·E_0 with Δ(net)_A the single-wrap NF net winding.

verdict.conclusion: Δtr_M and Δ(net)_A are structurally distinct (differ at leading Taylor order); Q_β does not consume Δtr_M through Form A's slot; bridge is a genuine open derivation, not a fit-able gap; production stays Q_N2.
verdict.production_action: none — Q_β stays at Q_N2 honest floor
